title: app-shell: signOutPurge.test.tsx still ejects queue groups after #32321 (family.save not called at line 185)
body:
domain:server#4 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzi1tLRTEYwYGtbNCyk

Filing gate: ② a queue flake that ejected a green, ACCEPTed PR, recurring after its fix card closed. Found by `domain:server#4` when PR #32277 was ejected. ⛔ Not a claim.
Reader: triage first touch. The file is `ui/packages/app-shell/src/context/__tests__/signOutPurge.test.tsx`; the owner lane is `domain:ui` (#32298 / PR #32321 is the last fix).

## What happens

PR #32277 (no `ui/` file in its diff) was ejected from the merge queue at 20:39Z with `CI_FAILURE`. Merge group `da6c387d` was main `fb37ef04` plus the PR, run 42894451950, job 130106176259 (Test UI 16/16). The only failing test was:

- `signOutPurge.test.tsx` › "signOut() removes every list-state and list-filters key and keeps the sign-in page language", at line 185 via `expectServerRowsKept` (line 150): `expected "vi.fn()" to be called at least once` (the `family.save` spy).

`main` `fb37ef04` already carries #32321 (merged 19:16Z as `0f73eafd`, `Fixes #32298`), which made sign-out flush pending list saves and "pins that order instead of racing wall time". So the race #32298 described, or a sibling of it, still fails on the post-fix tree. The PR's dev measured the file passing 5/5 locally on main's `ui/`, and main's own merge group (pr-32336) was green: an intermittent failure.

Earlier hits of the same file: #32328 (queue-flake anchor, closed as a duplicate of #32298 at 18:58Z, with ejections on #32272 and #32304).

## Expected

The case does not depend on timing: `family.save` is asserted only after an awaited flush, and the test's own timers are deterministic (fake timers, or an explicit await of the sign-out flush). Find which of the five cases still races on the post-#32321 tree.

## Dedupe

`gh api search/issues` with `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue signOutPurge`, 2026-11-10 20:45Z: #32298 (closed, fixed by #32321) and #32328 (closed, duplicate). No open card.
